content.title: League of Legends | Free Online Safety Guide
content.text: League of Legends (commonly referred to as LOL), is one of the most popular video games in the world, with millions of monthly players. It's available on Android, macOS and Windows, while Apple recently announced during its iPhone 12 launch event that it will soon be coming to iOS too. LOL is an esports game in which two teams of five face off and attempt to destroy the other's base. In the UK and Europe, PEGI rates League of Legends as suitable for age 12. However, to play the game, the user has to accept the Terms of Use, which state that the required age to play is 13+. In our guide, you'll find tips on topics including how to monitor gameplay, how to disable in-game spending and how to spot the signs of gaming addiction.Carly PageCarly Page is an experienced technology journalist with more than 10 years of experience in the industry. Previously the editor of tech tabloid The INQUIRER, Carly is now a freelance technology journalist, editor and consultant. She now works as news editor for Computer Shopper and IT Pro and writes for a number of publications including Forbes, TechRadar, Tes, The Metro, uSwitch and WIRED.
